errors.evidence: The figure is a composite chart, containing a pie chart on the left and a stacked bar chart on the right. The description incorrectly identifies the entire figure as just a pie chart, although it does describe the bar chart later.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns percentage values to the renewable energy sub-categories. The correct values are: Geothermal (3.1%), Ambient heat (5.3%), Solar (6.3%), and Wind (12.7%). The description assigns the value for Ambient heat to Geothermal, the value for Solar to Ambient heat, the value for Wind to Solar, and the value for Bioenergy & waste to Wind.
The description omits the value for 'Биоенергия и отпадъци' (Bioenergy & waste), which is 58.9% according to the chart. It only includes a placeholder percentage sign.

The description fails to mention the arrow that visually connects the 'Renewable energy' slice of the pie chart to the stacked bar chart, which indicates that the bar is a breakdown of that specific slice.
